_comment: The city's rail transit for the transit layer of the bake (tools/pipeline/src/world/transit*.ts; docs/contracts/m1-tile-format.md, 'transit.json'). Geometry, stations, platforms and entrances come from OpenStreetMap (ODbL, one cached Overpass query over `box`); this file adds what OSM does not say: the brand the game shows (a parody: the real agency's name and marks are trademarks and never appear), the line colours as the game draws them, the depths of the stations, the timetable (synthetic headways: no GTFS data is used, see docs/tools-wishlist.md) and the in-game names of stations whose real names are brands.
_routes: The OSM route relations the lines run on, one per direction (the full-length service patterns; the short turns are left out).
_stations: Depth: how far the top of each platform level lies below street level (m; negative is above the street, an elevated platform), by the platform's OSM layer. Street level is the highest ground at the station node and its entrances. Sources: Peachtree Center's platform is 120 ft (37 m) below Peachtree Street, the deepest in the system (Wikipedia, 'Peachtree Center station'); Five Points has a concourse under the street, the East-West platform below it and the North-South platform on the lowest level (Wikipedia, 'Five Points station'); the others are estimates from the OSM layers and the terrain. `name` renames a station whose real name is a brand (the brands policy: data/cities/atlanta/brands.json).

timetable._comment: Synthetic headways in timetable minutes by the game clock's time of day, per line and direction; `secondsPerMinute` is how many sim seconds a timetable minute lasts (the game clock runs 30 times faster than real time, so real minutes would be 30 game minutes apart: a 10-minute headway is 200 s here). Dwell at a station in sim seconds; the transfer station dwells longer.
